phase1_classification.kind_reason: A lifelong-learning benchmark with skill-grounded, interdependent tasks run strictly in sequence across DB (MySQL), OS (bash) and KG environments. Experience replay of 0-64 prior successful trajectories is scored by task success. It is framed as lifelong learning toward 'memory-capable LLM agents'.

phase1_verified_types.procedural_workflow: Sec.3: "evaluates agents on their ability to leverage past experience to improve current task performance"; Sec.5.3: "enforces strict sequential execution to preserve the integrity of experience accumulation"; Tables 2-5 vary Exp=0..64.
